FILE: README.md

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

import { api } from "@/api/axios";
import type { RegisterOutput } from "@/schemas/register.schema";

export interface RegisterResponse {
  id: string;
  message?: string;
}

export async function registerUser(payload: RegisterOutput): Promise<RegisterResponse> {
  const { data } = await api.post<RegisterResponse>("/registrations", payload);
  return data;
}

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  AnimatePresence,
  motion,
  useMotionValueEvent,
  useReducedMotion,
  useScroll,
  useSpring,
} from "motion/react";
import { ArrowUp } from "lucide-react";
import { WhatsAppIcon } from "@/components/common/WhatsAppIcon";
import { buildWhatsAppUrl } from "@/lib/whatsapp";

const SHOW_AFTER_PX = 300;

export function FloatingActions() {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const { scrollY, scrollYProgress } = useScroll();
  const progress = useSpring(scrollYProgress, { stiffness: 140, damping: 28, restDelta: 0.001 });
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(
    () => typeof window !== "undefined" && window.scrollY > SHOW_AFTER_PX,
  );

  useMotionValueEvent(scrollY, "change", (latest) => setVisible(latest > SHOW_AFTER_PX));

  const scrollToTop = () =>
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: reduceMotion ? "auto" : "smooth" });

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {visible && (
        <motion.div
          key="floating-actions"
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.8 }}
          transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 22 }}
          className="fixed bottom-5 right-4 z-40 flex flex-col items-center gap-3 sm:bottom-6 sm:right-6"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={scrollToTop}
            aria-label="Scroll to top"
            className="relative grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white text-maroon-800 shadow-lg shadow-maroon-900/20 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
          >
            <svg className="absolute inset-0 -rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true">
              <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="21" fill="none" stroke="#F5E1C6" strokeWidth="3" />
              <motion.circle
                cx="24"
                cy="24"
                r="21"
                fill="none"
                stroke="#7D1210"
                strokeWidth="3"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                style={{ pathLength: progress }}
              />
            </svg>
            <ArrowUp className="relative size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>

          <a
            href={buildWhatsAppUrl()}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            aria-label="Chat with Ahd-e-Rishta on WhatsApp"
            className="relative grid size-14 place-items-center rounded-full bg-[#15803d] text-white shadow-lg shadow-green-900/30 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
          >
            {!reduceMotion &&
              [0, 1].map((i) => (
                <motion.span
                  key={i}
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-2 border-[#15803d]"
                  animate={{ scale: [1, 1.7], opacity: [0.5, 0] }}
                  transition={{ duration: 2.2, repeat: Infinity, ease: "easeOut", delay: i * 1.1 }}
                />
              ))}
            <WhatsAppIcon className="relative size-7" />
          </a>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\common\ScrollReveal.tsx
========================================
import { motion, type HTMLMotionProps } from "motion/react";
import { fadeUp, staggerContainer } from "@/lib/animations/variants";

type MotionDivProps = HTMLMotionProps<"div">;

export interface ScrollRevealProps
  extends Omit<MotionDivProps, "variants" | "initial" | "animate" | "whileInView" | "viewport"> {
  /** When true, direct RevealItem children animate one after another */
  stagger?: boolean;
}

/** Animates its content once, when at least 20% of it is visible */
export function ScrollReveal({ stagger = false, ...props }: ScrollRevealProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial="hidden"
      whileInView="visible"
      viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.2 }}
      variants={stagger ? staggerContainer : fadeUp}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

/** A child of a stagger ScrollReveal. Inherits the parent's animation state. */
export function RevealItem(props: Omit<MotionDivProps, "variants">) {
  return <motion.div variants={fadeUp} {...props} />;
}

FILE: src\components\forms\ComboboxField.tsx
========================================
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Check, ChevronDown, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { controlClass } from "@/components/forms/FormField";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface ComboboxOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

interface ComboboxItem extends ComboboxOption {
  custom?: boolean;
}

interface ComboboxFieldProps {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  onBlur?: () => void;
  options: ComboboxOption[];
  placeholder?: string;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  searchLabel?: string;
  /** true: if the typed text is not in the list, a "Use ..." row lets the user pick it anyway */
  allowCustom?: boolean;
  invalid?: boolean;
  describedBy?: string;
}

export function ComboboxField({
  id,
  value,
  onChange,
  onBlur,
  options,
  placeholder = "Any",
  searchPlaceholder = "Search...",
  searchLabel = "Search options",
  allowCustom = false,
  invalid,
  describedBy,
}: ComboboxFieldProps) {
  const listId = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);

  const selectedOption = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
  const displayLabel = selectedOption?.label ?? value;

  const items = useMemo<ComboboxItem[]>(() => {
    const text = query.trim();
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    const matches = lower
      ? options.filter((option) => option.label.toLowerCase().includes(lower))
      : options;
    const hasExact = options.some((option) => option.label.toLowerCase() === lower);
    if (allowCustom && text && !hasExact) {
      return [...matches, { value: text, label: `Use "${text}"`, custom: true }];
    }
    return matches;
  }, [allowCustom, options, query]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) searchRef.current?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) document.getElementById(`${listId}-${activeIndex}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }, [open, activeIndex, listId]);

  const openList = () => {
    const index = options.findIndex((option) => option.value === value);
    setQuery("");
    setActiveIndex(index >= 0 ? index : 0);
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const close = (returnFocus = false) => {
    setOpen(false);
    setQuery("");
    if (returnFocus) triggerRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const select = (item: ComboboxItem) => {
    onChange(item.value);
    close(true);
  };

  const handleSearchKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((index) => Math.min(index + 1, items.length - 1));
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((index) => Math.max(index - 1, 0));
    } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
      // Never let Enter submit the form from inside the list
      event.preventDefault();
      const item = items[activeIndex];
      if (item) select(item);
    } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      close(true);
    } else if (event.key === "Tab") {
      close();
    }
  };

  const activeId = open && items[activeIndex] ? `${listId}-${activeIndex}` : undefined;

  return (
    <div
      className="relative"
      onBlur={(event) => {
        if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) {
          close();
          onBlur?.();
        }
      }}
    >
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        id={id}
        type="button"
        role="combobox"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={listId}
        aria-invalid={invalid ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        onClick={() => (open ? close() : openList())}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (!open) openList();
          }
        }}
        className={cn(controlClass, "flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl pr-3 text-left")}
      >
        <span className={cn("truncate", !displayLabel && "text-muted-foreground/70")}>
          {displayLabel || placeholder}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn("size-4 shrink-0 text-maroon-700 transition-transform duration-200", open && "rotate-180")}
        />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-30 mt-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-peach-400/60 bg-white shadow-xl shadow-maroon-900/15">
          <div className="relative border-b border-border p-1.5">
            <Search
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-maroon-700"
            />
            <input
              ref={searchRef}
              type="text"
              role="combobox"
              aria-label={searchLabel}
              aria-expanded
              aria-controls={listId}
              aria-activedescendant={activeId}
              aria-autocomplete="list"
              autoComplete="off"
              placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
              value={query}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setQuery(event.target.value);
                setActiveIndex(0);
              }}
              onKeyDown={handleSearchKeyDown}
              className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-cream-50 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-maroon-950 outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70 focus:border-maroon-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-maroon-700/20"
            />
          </div>

          <ul id={listId} role="listbox" className="max-h-52 overflow-auto p-1.5">
            {items.length === 0 && (
              <li className="px-3 py-3 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No results found</li>
            )}
            {items.map((item, index) => {
              const selected = !item.custom && item.value === value;
              const active = index === activeIndex;
              return (
                <li
                  key={`${item.custom ? "custom" : "option"}-${item.value || "__empty"}`}
                  id={`${listId}-${index}`}
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected={selected}
                  // Keep focus inside the search box while clicking an item
                  onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
                  onClick={() => select(item)}
                  onMouseMove={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-maroon-900 transition-colors",
                    active && "bg-cream-100",
                    selected && "bg-peach-400/40 font-medium text-maroon-800",
                    item.custom && "italic",
                  )}
                >
                  <span>{item.label}</span>
                  {selected && <Check className="size-4 shrink-0 text-maroon-700" aria-hidden="true" />}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { ComponentProps, ReactNode } from "react";

export const controlClass =
  "h-11 w-full rounded-full border border-border bg-cream-50 px-4 text-sm text-maroon-950 outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70 focus:border-maroon-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-maroon-700/20 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-2 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 disabled:opacity-60";

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm<LoginInput, unknown, LoginOutput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(loginSchema),
  });

  async function onSubmit(values: LoginOutput) {
    setServerError(null);
    try {
      // Endpoint apne backend ke mutabiq badal lein
      const res = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL}/auth/login`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(values),
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (!res.ok) {
        setServerError(data.message ?? "Incorrect phone number or password.");
        return;
      }

      // Token ka naam apne backend ke response ke mutabiq badal lein
      try {
        if (data.token) localStorage.setItem("ahd-e-rishta:token", data.token);
      } catch {
        // storage blocked ho to ignore
      }

      navigate("/");
    } catch {
      setServerError("Could not reach the server. Please try again.");
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-[2rem] border border-[#eadfce] bg-white p-6 shadow-xl shadow-[#5a0f19]/5 sm:p-10">
      <h2 className="font-serif text-3xl font-bold text-[#4a0a12]">Login</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[#4a0a12]/70">
        Enter your phone number and password.
      </p>

      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
        noValidate
        className="mt-8 space-y-5"
      >
        {/* Phone */}
        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="phone"
            className="mb-2 block font-medium text-[#4a0a12]"
          >
            Phone number
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Phone className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 h-5 w-5 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#7d1424]" />
            <input
              id="phone"
              type="tel"
              inputMode="numeric"
              autoComplete="tel"
              placeholder="0300 1234567"
              className={inputClass}
              aria-invalid={!!errors.phone}
              {...register("phone")}
            />
          </div>
          {errors.phone && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-red-600">
              {errors.phone.message}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Password */}
        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="password"
            className="mb-2 block font-medium text-[#4a0a12]"
          >
            Password
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 h-5 w-5 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#7d1424]" />
            <input
              id="password"
              type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
              autoComplete="current-password"
              placeholder="Your password"
              className={inputClass}
              aria-invalid={!!errors.password}
              {...register("password")}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowPassword((s) => !s)}
              aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#7d1424]/70 hover:text-[#7d1424]"
            >
              {showPassword ? (
                <EyeOff className="h-5 w-5" />
              ) : (
                <Eye className="h-5 w-5" />
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
          {errors.password && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-red-600">
              {errors.password.message}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {serverError && (
          <p
            role="alert"
            className="rounded-2xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700"
          >
            {serverError}
          </p>
        )}

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={isSubmitting}
          className="w-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7d1424] to-[#5a0f19] py-3.5 font-semibold text-[#f5e6c8] shadow-md transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {isSubmitting ? "Logging in..." : "Login"}
        </button>
      </form>

      <p className="mt-6 text-center text-[#4a0a12]/80">
        Don't have an account?{" "}
        <Link
          to="/register"
          className="font-semibold text-[#7d1424] hover:underline"
        >
          Register
        </Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, type Variants } from "motion/react";
import { Controller, useForm, type FieldErrors } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import roseBanner from "@/assets/rose-banner.svg";
import { ComboboxField } from "@/components/forms/ComboboxField";
import { FormField, NativeSelect, controlClass } from "@/components/forms/FormField";
import { RegisterSuccess } from "@/components/forms/RegisterSuccess";
import { registerSteps } from "@/components/forms/registerSteps";
import {
  buildRegistrationMessage,
  saveRegistrationLocally,
} from "@/components/forms/registerMessage";
import { WhatsAppIcon } from "@/components/common/WhatsAppIcon";
import { buildWhatsAppUrl } from "@/lib/whatsapp";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  registerSchema,
  type RegisterInput,
  type RegisterOutput,
} from "@/schemas/register.schema";

const slide: Variants = {
  enter: (direction: number) => ({ opacity: 0, x: direction * 24 }),
  center: { opacity: 1, x: 0 },
  exit: (direction: number) => ({ opacity: 0, x: direction * -24 }),
};

interface SubmittedRegistration {
  name: string;
  city: string;
  whatsappUrl: string;
}

// Har field shuru mein "" rakhein, taake "required" errors sahi dikhein
const emptyValues = {
  ...Object.fromEntries(
    registerSteps.flatMap((step) => step.fields.map((field) => [field.name, ""])),
  ),
  declaration: false,
} as unknown as RegisterInput;

export function RegisterForm() {
  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<1 | -1>(1);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState<SubmittedRegistration | null>(null);
  const headingRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const hasNavigated = useRef(false);

  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    trigger,
    watch,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<RegisterInput, unknown, RegisterOutput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(registerSchema),
    mode: "onTouched",
    defaultValues: emptyValues,
  });

  const totalSteps = registerSteps.length;
  const step = registerSteps[stepIndex];
  const isLast = stepIndex === totalSteps - 1;
  const declared = watch("declaration");
  const percent = Math.round(((stepIndex + 1) / totalSteps) * 100);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasNavigated.current) headingRef.current?.focus();
  }, [stepIndex]);

  // After submit, the success screen replaces the form. Scroll up so it is visible.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (submitted) window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [submitted]);

  const goToStep = (index: number, dir: 1 | -1) => {
    hasNavigated.current = true;
    setDirection(dir);
    setStepIndex(index);
  };

  const handleNext = async () => {
    const names = step.fields.map((field) => field.name);
    const isValid = await trigger(names, { shouldFocus: true });
    if (isValid) goToStep(stepIndex + 1, 1);
  };

  const onSubmit = (values: RegisterOutput) => {
    console.log("Registration form submitted:", values);
    saveRegistrationLocally(values);

    const whatsappUrl = buildWhatsAppUrl(buildRegistrationMessage(values));
    window.open(whatsappUrl, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");

    setSubmitted({ name: values.fullName, city: values.city, whatsappUrl });
  };

  // If something on an earlier step is invalid, jump back to the first such step
  const onInvalid = (formErrors: FieldErrors<RegisterInput>) => {
    const index = registerSteps.findIndex((s) => s.fields.some((field) => formErrors[field.name]));
    if (index !== -1) goToStep(index, -1);
  };

  const handleFormSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    if (!isLast) {
      // Pressing Enter on an earlier step moves forward instead of submitting
      event.preventDefault();
      void handleNext();
      return;
    }
    void handleSubmit(onSubmit, onInvalid)(event);
  };

  if (submitted) {
    return (
      <RegisterSuccess
        name={submitted.name}
        city={submitted.city}
        whatsappUrl={submitted.whatsappUrl}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl rounded-3xl border border-border bg-white p-5 shadow-xl shadow-maroon-900/10 sm:p-8">
      <div
        className="rounded-xl border border-peach-400/60 bg-cream-50 bg-cover bg-right bg-no-repeat px-4 py-3 pr-24 text-sm text-maroon-800 sm:pr-40"
        style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${roseBanner})` }}
      >
        <strong className="font-semibold">Note:</strong> Please fill each section carefully. When
        you submit, your details open in WhatsApp for our team.
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span>
            Step {stepIndex + 1} of {totalSteps}
          </span>
          <span>{percent}%</span>
        </div>
        <div
          role="progressbar"
          aria-label="Registration progress"
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={100}
          aria-valuenow={percent}
          className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-cream-100"
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={false}
            animate={{ scaleX: percent / 100 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 120, damping: 20 }}
            className="h-full origin-left rounded-full bg-linear-to-r from-peach-400 to-maroon-600"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <form noValidate onSubmit={handleFormSubmit} className="mt-6">
        <h2
          ref={headingRef}
          tabIndex={-1}
          className="font-heading text-xl font-semibold text-maroon-800 outline-none"
        >
          {step.title}
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{step.description}</p>

        {/* No overflow-hidden on this wrapper, otherwise the dropdown lists get cut off */}
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" custom={direction} initial={false}>
          <motion.div
            key={step.id}
            custom={direction}
            variants={slide}
            initial="enter"
            animate="center"
            exit="exit"
            transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: "easeOut" }}
            className="mt-5 grid gap-x-5 gap-y-4 sm:grid-cols-2"
          >
            {step.fields.map((field) => {
              const id = `field-${field.name}`;
              const error = errors[field.name]?.message;
              const aria = {
                "aria-invalid": error ? true : undefined,
                "aria-describedby": error ? `${id}-error` : undefined,
              } as const;

              return (
                <FormField
                  key={field.name}
                  id={id}
                  label={field.label}
                  error={error}
                  className={field.fullWidth ? "sm:col-span-2" : undefined}
                >
                  {field.kind === "text" && (
                    <Input
                      id={id}
                      type={field.inputType ?? "text"}
                      inputMode={field.inputMode}
                      autoComplete={field.autoComplete}
                      placeholder={field.placeholder}
                      className={controlClass}
                      {...aria}
                      {...register(field.name)}

                  {field.kind === "select" && (

                          onChange={controller.onChange}
                          onBlur={controller.onBlur}
                          options={field.options}
                          allowCustom={field.allowCustom}
                          invalid={Boolean(error)}
                          describedBy={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
                        />
                      )}
                    />
                  )}

                  {field.kind === "textarea" && (
                    <textarea
                      id={id}
                      rows={4}
                      placeholder={field.placeholder}
                      className={cn(controlClass, "h-auto min-h-28 rounded-2xl py-3")}
                      {...aria}
                      {...register(field.name)}
                    />
                  )}
                </FormField>
              );
            })}

            {isLast && (
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label
                  htmlFor="field-declaration"
                  className={cn(

                  )}
                >
                  <input
                    id="field-declaration"
                    type="checkbox"
                    className="mt-1 size-4 shrink-0 accent-maroon-700"
                    aria-invalid={errors.declaration ? true : undefined}
                    {...register("declaration")}
                  />
                  <span className="space-y-2 text-sm text-maroon-900">
                    <span className="block">
                      I declare that the information provided above is true and accurate to the best
                      of my knowledge.
                    </span>
                    <span lang="ur" dir="rtl" className="block text-muted-foreground">
                      Ù…ÛŒÚº Ø§Ù‚Ø±Ø§Ø± Ú©Ø±ØªØ§/Ú©Ø±ØªÛŒ ÛÙˆÚº Ú©Û Ø§ÙˆÙ¾Ø± Ø¯ÛŒ Ú¯Ø¦ÛŒ Ù…Ø¹Ù„ÙˆÙ…Ø§Øª Ù…ÛŒØ±Û’ Ø¹Ù„Ù… Ú©Û’ Ù…Ø·Ø§Ø¨Ù‚ Ø¯Ø±Ø³Øª Ø§ÙˆØ± Ø³Ú†ÛŒ ÛÛŒÚºÛ”
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </label>
                {errors.declaration?.message && (
                  <p role="alert" className="mt-1.5 px-1 text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                    {errors.declaration.message}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>

        <div className="mt-8 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            className="h-11 rounded-full px-5"
            onClick={() => goToStep(stepIndex - 1, -1)}
            disabled={stepIndex === 0}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />

          {/* Different keys so React never reuses one DOM button for both types */}
          {isLast ? (

            >
              Continue
              <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\forms\registerMessage.ts
========================================
import { registerSteps, type StepField } from "@/components/forms/registerSteps";
import type { RegisterOutput } from "@/schemas/register.schema";

const STORAGE_KEY = "ahd-e-rishta:last-registration";

/** Dropdowns store a value like "never_married", so show the label instead */
function displayValue(field: StepField, value: string): string {
  if (field.kind !== "select") return value;
  return field.options.find((option) => option.value === value)?.label ?? value;
}

/** One labelled line per field, grouped by step */
export function buildRegistrationMessage(values: RegisterOutput): string {
  const lines: string[] = [
    "Assalam-o-Alaikum, I have just filled the registration form on Ahd-e-Rishta. My details:",
    "",
  ];

  for (const step of registerSteps) {
    lines.push(`*${step.title}*`);
    for (const field of step.fields) {
      const value = displayValue(field, values[field.name]).trim();
      lines.push(`${field.label}: ${value || "-"}`);
    }
    lines.push("");
  }

  return lines.join("\n").trim();
}

/** Keeps a copy in this browser. Storage can be blocked (private mode), so failures are ignored. */
export function saveRegistrationLocally(values: RegisterOutput): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(
      STORAGE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({ savedAt: new Date().toISOString(), values }),
    );
  } catch {
    // The WhatsApp message still carries all the data.
  }
}

FILE: src\components\forms\registerSteps.ts

import type { RegisterInput } from "@/schemas/register.schema";
import {
  casteSuggestions,
  citySuggestions,
  educationSuggestions,
  heightRegisterSuggestions,
  incomeSuggestions,
  occupationSuggestions,
  religionSuggestions,
  sectSuggestions,
} from "@/lib/filterOptions";

export type FieldName = Exclude<keyof RegisterInput, "declaration">;

export interface SelectOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

interface FieldBase {
  name: FieldName;
  label: string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}

interface TextField extends FieldBase {
  kind: "text";
  placeholder: string;
  inputType?: "text" | "date" | "tel";
  inputMode?: "text" | "numeric" | "tel";
  autoComplete?: string;
}

/** Simple dropdown: user sirf list mein se chun sakta hai */
interface SelectField extends FieldBase {
  kind: "select";
  options: SelectOption[];
}

/** Searchable dropdown: allowCustom true ho to user apni value bhi likh sakta hai */
interface ComboboxFieldConfig extends FieldBase {
  kind: "combobox";
  options: SelectOption[];
  allowCustom: boolean;
}

interface TextareaField extends FieldBase {
  kind: "textarea";
  placeholder: string;
}

export type StepField = TextField | SelectField | ComboboxFieldConfig | TextareaField;

export interface RegisterStep {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  fields: StepField[];
}

// ------------------------------
// Option helpers
// ------------------------------

const toOptions = (items: string[]): SelectOption[] =>
  items.map((item) => ({ value: item, label: item }));

const withAny = (items: string[], label = "Any"): string[] => [label, ...items];

const numberOptions = (from: number, to: number, suffix = ""): SelectOption[] =>
  Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => {
    const text = `${from + i}${suffix}`;
    return { value: text, label: text };
  });

import { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import { RevealItem, ScrollReveal } from "@/components/common/ScrollReveal";
import { SectionHeading } from "./Sectionheading";
import { faqs } from "@/lib/homeContent";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function FaqSection() {
  const [openIndex, setOpenIndex] = useState<number | null>(0);

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="faq-title" className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl px-4 py-16 sm:px-6">
      <ScrollReveal stagger className="space-y-10">
        <SectionHeading id="faq-title" eyebrow="Questions" title="Frequently Asked Questions" />

        <RevealItem>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {faqs.map((faq, index) => {
              const isOpen = openIndex === index;
              const panelId = `faq-panel-${index}`;
              return (
                <div key={faq.question} className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-white">
                  <h3>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-expanded={isOpen}
                      aria-controls={panelId}
                      onClick={() => setOpenIndex(isOpen ? null : index)}
                      className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 px-5 py-4 text-left font-semibold text-maroon-800"
                    >
                      {faq.question}
                      <ChevronDown
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        className={cn("size-5 shrink-0 transition-transform", isOpen && "rotate-180")}
                      />
                    </button>
                  </h3>
                  <div
                    id={panelId}
                    hidden={!isOpen}
                    className="px-5 pb-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    {faq.answer}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </RevealItem>
      </ScrollReveal>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\home\FindMatchSection.tsx
========================================
import { Controller, useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { ComboboxField, type ComboboxOption } from "@/components/forms/ComboboxField";
import { FormField, controlClass } from "@/components/forms/FormField";
import { RevealItem, ScrollReveal } from "@/components/common/ScrollReveal";
import {
  ageFilterOptions,
  casteSuggestions,
  citySuggestions,
  countrySuggestions,
  educationSuggestions,
  genderFilterOptions,
  maritalFilterOptions,
  religionSuggestions,
  sectSuggestions,
} from "@/lib/filterOptions";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  emptyFilters,
  matchFilterSchema,
  type MatchFilterInput,
  type MatchFilterOutput,
} from "@/schemas/matchFilter.schema";

interface FilterField {
  name: keyof MatchFilterInput;
  label: string;
  options: ComboboxOption[];
  /** true for fields where the user can type their own value */
  allowCustom: boolean;
}

const toOptions = (items: string[]): ComboboxOption[] =>
  items.map((item) => ({ value: item, label: item }));

// Same order as the reference: row 1 (5 fields), row 2 (5 fields), then search and buttons
const filterFields: FilterField[] = [
  { name: "gender", label: "Gender", options: genderFilterOptions, allowCustom: false },
  { name: "caste", label: "Caste", options: toOptions(casteSuggestions), allowCustom: true },
  { name: "maritalStatus", label: "Marital Status", options: maritalFilterOptions, allowCustom: false },
  { name: "city", label: "City", options: toOptions(citySuggestions), allowCustom: true },
  { name: "country", label: "Country", options: toOptions(countrySuggestions), allowCustom: true },
  { name: "religion", label: "Religion", options: toOptions(religionSuggestions), allowCustom: true },
  { name: "sect", label: "Sect", options: toOptions(sectSuggestions), allowCustom: true },
  { name: "education", label: "Education", options: toOptions(educationSuggestions), allowCustom: true },
  { name: "ageFrom", label: "Age From", options: ageFilterOptions, allowCustom: false },
  { name: "ageTo", label: "Age To", options: ageFilterOptions, allowCustom: false },
];

function toSearch(values: MatchFilterOutput): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
    if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") params.set(key, value.trim());
  }
  return params.toString();
}

export function FindMatchSection() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    reset,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<MatchFilterInput, unknown, MatchFilterOutput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(matchFilterSchema),
    defaultValues: emptyFilters,
  });

  const onSubmit = (values: MatchFilterOutput) => {
    navigate({ pathname: "/profiles", search: toSearch(values) });
  };

  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby="find-match-title"
      className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 pt-6 pb-16 sm:px-6"
    >
      <ScrollReveal stagger className="space-y-8">
        <RevealItem className="text-center">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.3em] text-muted-foreground uppercase">
            Welcome to Ahd-e-Rishta
          </p>
          <h2
            id="find-match-title"
            className="mt-3 font-heading text-3xl font-bold text-maroon-700 sm:text-5xl"
          >
            Find Your Perfect Match
          </h2>
          <div
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="mx-auto mt-4 h-1 w-24 rounded-full bg-linear-to-r from-maroon-700 to-peach-400"
          />
        </RevealItem>

        <RevealItem>
          {/* No overflow-hidden here, otherwise the dropdown lists get cut at the card edge */}
          <div className="rounded-3xl border border-border bg-white shadow-xl shadow-maroon-900/10">
            <div
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="h-1.5 rounded-t-3xl bg-linear-to-r from-maroon-700 via-peach-400 to-maroon-700"
            />

            <form
              noValidate
              onSubmit={(event) => void handleSubmit(onSubmit)(event)}
              className="grid gap-x-5 gap-y-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:p-8 lg:grid-cols-5"
            >
              {filterFields.map((field) => {
                const id = `filter-${field.name}`;
                const error = errors[field.name]?.message;

                return (
                  <FormField key={field.name} id={id} label={field.label} error={error}>
                    <Controller
                      name={field.name}
                      control={control}
                      render={({ field: controller }) => (
                        <ComboboxField
                          id={id}
                          value={String(controller.value ?? "")}
                          onChange={controller.onChange}
                          onBlur={controller.onBlur}
                          options={field.options}
                          allowCustom={field.allowCustom}
                          invalid={Boolean(error)}
                          describedBy={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
                        />
                      )}
                    />
                  </FormField>
                );
              })}

              {/* Bottom row: search on the left, buttons on the right (like the reference) */}
              <FormField
                id="filter-q"
                label="Search by ID / Name"
                error={errors.q?.message}
                className="sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3"
              >
                <div className="relative">
                  <Search
                    aria-hidden="true"

FILE: src\components\home\HeroCarousel.tsx
========================================
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Autoplay from "embla-carousel-autoplay";
import { useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import {
  Carousel,
  CarouselContent,
  CarouselItem,
  CarouselNext,
  CarouselPrevious,
  type CarouselApi,
} from "@/components/ui/carousel";
import { heroSlides, type HeroSlide } from "@/lib/heroSlides";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** Slides ke darmiyan waqt (milliseconds) */
const AUTOPLAY_MS = 3000;

interface HeroCarouselProps {
  /** Admin panel se aaya hua data. Na diya jaye to dummy data dikhta hai. */
  slides?: HeroSlide[];
}

function Slide({ slide, index }: { slide: HeroSlide; index: number }) {
  const hasText = Boolean(slide.heading || slide.subheading);

  return (
    <article className="relative h-64 w-full overflow-hidden bg-cream-100 sm:h-80 lg:h-[28rem]">
      <img
        src={slide.image}
        // Text maujood ho to image sirf decorative hai, warna screen reader ko batayein
        alt={hasText ? "" : `Slide ${index + 1}`}
        loading={index === 0 ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        className="size-full object-cover"
      />

      {/* Cream panel sirf tab, jab heading ya subheading ho: maroon text ka contrast hamesha acha rahe */}
      {hasText && (
        <div className="absolute inset-x-4 bottom-12 sm:inset-x-auto sm:bottom-14 sm:left-10 sm:max-w-xl">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-peach-400/60 bg-cream-50/90 px-5 py-4 shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm sm:px-7 sm:py-5">
            {slide.heading && (
              <h2 className="font-heading text-2xl font-semibold text-maroon-800 sm:text-4xl">
                {slide.heading}
              </h2>
            )}
            {slide.subheading && (
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-maroon-700 sm:text-lg">
                {slide.subheading}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

export function HeroCarousel({ slides = heroSlides }: HeroCarouselProps) {
  const [api, setApi] = useState<CarouselApi>();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0);
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();

  const autoplay = useMemo(
    () => Autoplay({ delay: AUTOPLAY_MS, stopOnInteraction: false, stopOnMouseEnter: true }),
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!api) return;
    const onSelect = () => setSelected(api.selectedScrollSnap());
    onSelect();
    api.on("select", onSelect);
    api.on("reInit", onSelect);
    return () => {
      api.off("select", onSelect);
      api.off("reInit", onSelect);
    };
  }, [api]);

  if (slides.length === 0) return null;

  const hasMany = slides.length > 1;

  return (
    <Carousel
      setApi={setApi}
      opts={{ loop: hasMany }}
      plugins={reduceMotion || !hasMany ? [] : [autoplay]}
      aria-label="Featured highlights"
      className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl shadow-xl shadow-maroon-900/15"
    >
      <CarouselContent className="ml-0">
        {slides.map((slide, index) => (
          <CarouselItem
            key={slide.id}
            className="pl-0"
            aria-label={`${index + 1} of ${slides.length}`}
          >
            <Slide slide={slide} index={index} />
          </CarouselItem>
        ))}
      </CarouselContent>

      {/* Arrows aur dots sirf tab, jab ek se zyada slides hon */}
      {hasMany && (
        <>
          <CarouselPrevious className="left-3 border-white/30 bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur hover:bg-white/25 hover:text-white sm:left-5" />
          <CarouselNext className="right-3 border-white/30 bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur hover:bg-white/25 hover:text-white sm:right-5" />

          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-4 flex justify-center gap-2">
            {slides.map((slide, index) => (
              <button
                key={slide.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => api?.scrollTo(index)}
                aria-label={`Go to slide ${index + 1}`}
                aria-current={index === selected}
                className={cn(
                  "h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white",
                  index === selected
                    ? "w-7 bg-maroon-700 ring-1 ring-white/70"
                    : "w-2 bg-white/80 shadow hover:bg-white",
                )}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </Carousel>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\home\Statssection.tsx
========================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { RevealItem, ScrollReveal } from "@/components/common/ScrollReveal";
import { stats } from "@/lib/homeContent";

/** Number screen par aate hi 0 se ginti shuru karta hai */
function CountUp({ value, suffix }: { value: number; suffix: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [display, setDisplay] = useState(0);
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current;
    if (!element) return;

    if (reduceMotion) {
      setDisplay(value);
      return;
    }

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        observer.disconnect();

        const start = performance.now();
        const duration = 1500;
        const tick = (now: number) => {
          const progress = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
          setDisplay(Math.round(value * (1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3))));
          if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      },
      { threshold: 0.4 },
    );

    observer.observe(element);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [value, reduceMotion]);

  return (
    <span ref={ref}>
      {display.toLocaleString("en-US")}
      {suffix}
    </span>
  );
}

export function StatsSection() {
  return (
    <section
      aria-label="Our achievements"
      className="bg-linear-to-r from-maroon-950 via-maroon-800 to-maroon-600 py-12 sm:py-14"
    >
      <ScrollReveal stagger className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-2 gap-8 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {stats.map((stat) => (
          <RevealItem key={stat.label} className="text-center text-white">
            <p className="font-heading text-4xl font-bold sm:text-5xl">
              <CountUp value={stat.value} suffix={stat.suffix} />
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-peach-400 sm:text-base">{stat.label}</p>
          </RevealItem>
        ))}
      </ScrollReveal>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\layout\GlobalSearch.tsx
========================================
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface GlobalSearchProps {
  className?: string;
  /** "dark" is for the maroon header, "light" is for the cream mobile menu */
  tone?: "dark" | "light";
  onSearch?: () => void;
}

export function GlobalSearch({ className, tone = "dark", onSearch }: GlobalSearchProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const value = query.trim();
    if (!value) return;
    navigate(`/profiles?q=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`);
    onSearch?.();
  };

  const isDark = tone === "dark";

  return (
    <form role="search" onSubmit={handleSubmit} className={cn("relative", className)}>
      <input
        type="search"
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
        placeholder="Search by ID or name"
        aria-label="Search profiles by ID or name"
        className={cn(
          "h-10 w-full rounded-full border pl-4 pr-10 text-sm outline-none transition-colors",
          isDark
            ? "border-white/20 bg-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-white/60 focus:border-white/50 focus:bg-white/15"
            : "border-border bg-white text-maroon-900 placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-maroon-700",
        )}
      />
      <button
        type="submit"
        aria-label="Search"
        className={cn(
          "absolute right-1.5 top-1/2 grid size-7 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1",
          isDark

import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "motion/react";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";

  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,

  SheetTrigger,

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function MobileMenu() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const closeMenu = () => setOpen(false);

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <SheetTrigger
        aria-label="Open navigation menu"
        className="inline-flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/30 bg-white/10 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-white/20 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white xl:hidden"
      >
        <Menu className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
      </SheetTrigger>

      <SheetContent
        side="right"
        className="w-[85vw] max-w-sm gap-0 border-l-peach-400 bg-cream-50 p-0"
      >
        <SheetHeader className="border-b border-border px-6 py-5">
          <SheetTitle className="font-heading text-lg text-maroon-800">Menu</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>Browse Ahd-e-Rishta</SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>

        <div className="border-b border-border px-5 py-4">
          <GlobalSearch tone="light" onSearch={closeMenu} />
        </div>

        <motion.nav
          aria-label="Mobile"
          variants={staggerContainer}
          initial="hidden"
          animate="visible"
          className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-1 overflow-y-auto p-4"
        >
                   {navItems.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            return (
              <motion.div key={item.to} variants={fadeUp}>
                <NavLink
                  to={item.to}
                  end={item.to === "/"}
                  onClick={closeMenu}
                  className={({ isActive }) =>
                    cn(
                      "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-lg font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring",
                      isActive
                        ? "bg-peach-400 text-maroon-800"
                        : "text-maroon-800 hover:bg-cream-100",
                    )
                  }
                >
                  {Icon && <Icon className="size-5 text-maroon-700" aria-hidden="true" />}
                  <span>{item.label}</span>
                  {item.badge && <NavBadge>{item.badge}</NavBadge>}
                </NavLink>

                {item.children && (
                  <ul className="ml-11 mt-1 flex flex-col gap-1 border-l border-peach-400/60 pl-3">
                    {item.children.map((child) => (
                      <li key={child.to}>
                        <NavLink
                          to={child.to}
                          onClick={closeMenu}
                          className="block rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-base text-maroon-800 transition-colors hover:bg-cream-100 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
                        >
                          {child.label}
                        </NavLink>
                      </li>

                  </ul>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </motion.nav>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-border p-6">
          <Link
            to="/register"
            onClick={closeMenu}

            Register

const underlineBase = "absolute inset-x-2 -bottom-1 h-[3px] origin-center rounded-full";

/** Peach underline for the active link. Motion slides the same element between links. */
export function ActiveUnderline() {
  return (
    <motion.span
      layoutId="nav-underline"
      transition={transitions.pill}
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn(underlineBase, "bg-peach-400 shadow-sm shadow-peach-400/50")}
    />
  );
}

/** Thin cream underline that grows from the center on hover */
export function HoverUnderline() {
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn(
        underlineBase,
        "scale-x-0 bg-cream-100/70 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out group-hover:scale-x-100",
      )}
    />
  );
}

export function NavBadge({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Badge className="border-transparent bg-peach-400 px-1.5 py-0 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-maroon-700 hover:bg-peach-400">
      {children}
    </Badge>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\profiles\ProfilePhoto.tsx
========================================
import { User } from "lucide-react";
import type { Profile } from "@/lib/profiles";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface ProfilePhotoProps {
  profile: Pick<Profile, "name" | "photo">;
  className?: string;
}

/** Photo ho to photo, warna khoobsurat placeholder (initials ke saath). */
export function ProfilePhoto({ profile, className }: ProfilePhotoProps) {
  if (profile.photo) {
    return (
      <img
        src={profile.photo}
        alt={`Photo of ${profile.name}`}
        loading="lazy"
        className={cn("size-full object-cover", className)}
      />
    );
  }

  const initials = profile.name
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\s]/gu, "")
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((word) => word[0])
    .join("")
    .slice(0, 2)
    .toUpperCase();

  return (
    <div
      role="img"
      aria-label="Photo shared on request"
      className={cn(
        "relative flex size-full flex-col items-center justify-center bg-linear-to-br from-cream-100 via-peach-400/40 to-maroon-600/60",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <User className="absolute size-3/5 text-white/40" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.2} />
      <span className="relative font-heading text-5xl font-bold text-maroon-800/80">{initials}</span>
      <span className="relative mt-2 rounded-full bg-white/70 px-3 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-maroon-800">
        Photo on request
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/accordion"
import { cn } from "cn"
import { ChevronDownIcon, ChevronUpIcon } from "lucide-react"

function Accordion({ className, ...props }: AccordionPrimitive.Root.Props) {
  return (
    <AccordionPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="accordion"
      className={cn("flex w-full flex-col", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AccordionItem({ className, ...props }: AccordionPrimitive.Item.Props) {
  return (
    <AccordionPrimitive.Item
      data-slot="accordion-item"
      className={cn("not-last:border-b", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AccordionTrigger({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: AccordionPrimitive.Trigger.Props) {
  return (
    <AccordionPrimitive.Header className="flex">
      <AccordionPrimitive.Trigger
        data-slot="accordion-trigger"
        className={cn(
          "group/accordion-trigger relative flex flex-1 items-start justify-between rounded-lg border border-transparent py-2.5 text-left text-sm font-medium transition-all outline-none hover:underline focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:after:border-ring aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 **:data-[slot=accordion-trigger-icon]:ml-auto **:data-[slot=accordion-trigger-icon]:size-4 **:data-[slot=accordion-trigger-icon]:text-muted-foreground",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        <ChevronDownIcon data-slot="accordion-trigger-icon" className="pointer-events-none shrink-0 group-aria-expanded/accordion-trigger:hidden" />
        <ChevronUpIcon data-slot="accordion-trigger-icon" className="pointer-events-none hidden shrink-0 group-aria-expanded/accordion-trigger:inline" />
      </AccordionPrimitive.Trigger>
    </AccordionPrimitive.Header>
  )
}

function AccordionContent({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: AccordionPrimitive.Panel.Props) {
  return (
    <AccordionPrimitive.Panel
      data-slot="accordion-content"
      className="overflow-hidden text-sm data-open:animate-accordion-down data-closed:animate-accordion-up"
      {...props}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "h-(--accordion-panel-height) pt-0 pb-2.5 data-ending-style:h-0 data-starting-style:h-0 [&_a]:underline [&_a]:underline-offset-3 [&_a]:hover:text-foreground [&_p:not(:last-child)]:mb-4",
          className
        )}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </AccordionPrimitive.Panel>
  )
}

export { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent }

FILE: src\components\ui\badge.tsx

import { mergeProps } from "@base-ui/react/merge-props"
import { useRender } from "@base-ui/react/use-render"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "cn"

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "group/badge inline-flex h-5 w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3!",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-primary/80",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-secondary/80",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a]:hover:bg-destructive/20",
        outline:
          "border-border text-foreground [a]:hover:bg-muted [a]:hover:text-muted-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  render,
  ...props
}: useRender.ComponentProps<"span"> & VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants>) {
  return useRender({
    defaultTagName: "span",
    props: mergeProps<"span">(
      {
        className: cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className),
      },
      props
    ),
    render,
    state: {
      slot: "badge",
      variant,
    },
  })
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants }

FILE: src\components\ui\carousel.tsx
========================================
import * as React from "react"
import { cn } from "cn"
import useEmblaCarousel, {
  type UseEmblaCarouselType,
} from "embla-carousel-react"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react"

type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1]
type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>
type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0]
type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1]

type CarouselProps = {
  opts?: CarouselOptions
  plugins?: CarouselPlugin
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"
  setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void
}

type CarouselContextProps = {
  carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0]
  api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1]
  scrollPrev: () => void
  scrollNext: () => void
  canScrollPrev: boolean
  canScrollNext: boolean
} & CarouselProps

const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null)

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />")
  }

  return context
}

function Carousel({
  orientation = "horizontal",
  opts,
  setApi,
  plugins,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & CarouselProps) {
  const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
    {
      ...opts,
      axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
    },
    plugins
  )
  const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false)
  const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false)

  const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
    if (!api) return
    setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev())
    setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext())
  }, [])

  const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollPrev()
  }, [api])

  const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollNext()
  }, [api])

  const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
    (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
        event.preventDefault()
        scrollPrev()
      } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
        event.preventDefault()
        scrollNext()
      }
    },
    [scrollPrev, scrollNext]
  )

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api || !setApi) return
    setApi(api)
  }, [api, setApi])

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api) return
    onSelect(api)
    api.on("reInit", onSelect)
    api.on("select", onSelect)

    return () => {
      api?.off("select", onSelect)
    }
  }, [api, onSelect])

  return (
    <CarouselContext.Provider
      value={{
        carouselRef,
        api: api,
        opts,
        orientation:
          orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
        scrollPrev,
        scrollNext,
        canScrollPrev,
        canScrollNext,
      }}
    >
      <div
        onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
        className={cn("relative", className)}
        role="region"
        aria-roledescription="carousel"
        data-slot="carousel"
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </CarouselContext.Provider>
  )
}

function CarouselContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div
      ref={carouselRef}
      className="overflow-hidden"
      data-slot="carousel-content"
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex",
          orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

function CarouselItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const { orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      aria-roledescription="slide"
      data-slot="carousel-item"
      className={cn(
        "min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full",
        orientation === "horizontal" ? "pl-4" : "pt-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CarouselPrevious({
  className,
  variant = "outline",
  size = "icon-sm",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { orientation, scrollPrev, canScrollPrev } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      data-slot="carousel-previous"
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute touch-manipulation rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "inset-y-0 -left-12 my-auto"
          : "-top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollPrev}
      onClick={scrollPrev}
      {...props}
    >
      <ChevronLeftIcon />
      <span className="sr-only">Previous slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

function CarouselNext({
  className,
  variant = "outline",
  size = "icon-sm",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { orientation, scrollNext, canScrollNext } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      data-slot="carousel-next"
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute touch-manipulation rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "inset-y-0 -right-12 my-auto"
          : "-bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollNext}
      onClick={scrollNext}
      {...props}
    >
      <ChevronRightIcon />
      <span className="sr-only">Next slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

export {
  type CarouselApi,
  Carousel,
  CarouselContent,
  CarouselItem,
  CarouselPrevious,
  CarouselNext,
  useCarousel,
}

      {...props}
    />
  )

  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props

  showCloseButton?: boolean

          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close
            data-slot="dialog-close"
            render={
              <Button
                variant="ghost"

import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "cn"

import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"

function FieldSet({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"fieldset">) {
  return (
    <fieldset
      data-slot="field-set"
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col gap-4 has-[>[data-slot=checkbox-group]]:gap-3 has-[>[data-slot=radio-group]]:gap-3",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldLegend({
  className,
  variant = "legend",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"legend"> & { variant?: "legend" | "label" }) {
  return (
    <legend
      data-slot="field-legend"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(
        "mb-1.5 font-medium data-[variant=label]:text-sm data-[variant=legend]:text-base",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldGroup({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="field-group"
      className={cn(
        "group/field-group @container/field-group flex w-full flex-col gap-5 data-[slot=checkbox-group]:gap-3 *:data-[slot=field-group]:gap-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

const fieldVariants = cva(
  "group/field flex w-full gap-2 data-[invalid=true]:text-destructive",
  {
    variants: {
      orientation: {
        vertical: "flex-col *:w-full [&>.sr-only]:w-auto",
        horizontal:
          "flex-row items-center has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:items-start *:data-[slot=field-label]:flex-auto has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:[&>[role=checkbox],[role=radio]]:mt-px",
        responsive:
          "flex-col *:w-full @md/field-group:flex-row @md/field-group:items-center @md/field-group:*:w-auto @md/field-group:has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:items-start @md/field-group:*:data-[slot=field-label]:flex-auto [&>.sr-only]:w-auto @md/field-group:has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:[&>[role=checkbox],[role=radio]]:mt-px",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      orientation: "vertical",
    },
  }
)

function Field({
  className,
  orientation = "vertical",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & VariantProps<typeof fieldVariants>) {
  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      data-slot="field"
      data-orientation={orientation}
      className={cn(fieldVariants({ orientation }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="field-content"
      className={cn(
        "group/field-content flex flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5 leading-snug",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldLabel({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Label>) {
  return (
    <Label
      data-slot="field-label"
      className={cn(
        "group/field-label peer/field-label flex w-fit gap-2 leading-snug group-data-[disabled=true]/field:opacity-50 has-data-checked:border-primary/30 has-data-checked:bg-primary/5 has-[>[data-slot=field]]:rounded-lg has-[>[data-slot=field]]:border has-[>[data-slot=field]]:not-has-[:disabled,[data-disabled]]:hover:bg-muted/50 has-[>[data-slot=field]]:has-[:focus-visible]:border-ring has-[>[data-slot=field]]:has-[:focus-visible]:ring-3 has-[>[data-slot=field]]:has-[:focus-visible]:ring-ring/50 *:data-[slot=field]:p-2.5 dark:has-data-checked:border-primary/20 dark:has-data-checked:bg-primary/10",
        "has-[>[data-slot=field]]:w-full has-[>[data-slot=field]]:flex-col",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="field-label"
      className={cn(
        "flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium group-data-[disabled=true]/field:opacity-50",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  return (
    <p
      data-slot="field-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-left text-sm leading-normal font-normal text-muted-foreground group-has-data-horizontal/field:text-balance [[data-variant=legend]+&]:-mt-1.5",
        "last:mt-0 nth-last-2:-mt-1",
        "[&>a]:underline [&>a]:underline-offset-4 [&>a:hover]:text-primary",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldSeparator({
  children,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  children?: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="field-separator"
      data-content={!!children}
      className={cn(
        "relative -my-2 h-5 text-sm group-data-[variant=outline]/field-group:-mb-2",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <Separator className="absolute inset-0 top-1/2" />
      {children && (
        <span
          className="relative mx-auto block w-fit bg-background px-2 text-muted-foreground"
          data-slot="field-separator-content"
        >
          {children}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function FieldError({
  className,
  children,
  errors,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  errors?: Array<{ message?: string } | undefined>
}) {
  const content = useMemo(() => {
    if (children) {
      return children
    }

    if (!errors?.length) {
      return null
    }

    const uniqueErrors = [
      ...new Map(errors.map((error) => [error?.message, error])).values(),
    ]

    if (uniqueErrors?.length == 1) {
      return uniqueErrors[0]?.message
    }

    return (
      <ul className="ml-4 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1">
        {uniqueErrors.map(
          (error, index) =>
            error?.message && <li key={index}>{error.message}</li>
        )}
      </ul>
    )
  }, [children, errors])

  if (!content) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      data-slot="field-error"
      className={cn("text-sm font-normal text-destructive", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {content}
    </div>
  )
}

export {
  Field,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSeparator,
  FieldSet,
  FieldContent,
  FieldTitle,
}

          "--normal-bg": "var(--popover)",
          "--normal-text": "var(--popover-foreground)",

      }
      toastOptions={{
        classNames: {
          toast: "cn-toast",
        },
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

/** Returns true once the page has scrolled past the threshold (in px). */
export function useIsScrolled(threshold = 24): boolean {
  const [isScrolled, setIsScrolled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      setIsScrolled(window.scrollY > threshold);
    };

    handleScroll(); // set the correct value on mount, e.g. after a refresh
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });

    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, [threshold]);

  return isScrolled;
}

import { z } from "zod";

const envSchema = z.object({
  VITE_API_URL: z.url("VITE_API_URL must be a valid URL, e.g. http://localhost:5000/api"),
  VITE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER: z
    .string()
    .regex(
      /^\d{10,15}$/,
      "VITE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER must be digits only, with country code (e.g. 923001234567)",
    ),
  VITE_WHATSAPP_MESSAGE: z
    .string()
    .default("Assalam-o-Alaikum, I would like to know more about Ahd-e-Rishta."),
});

const parsed = envSchema.safeParse(import.meta.env);

if (!parsed.success) {
  const details = parsed.error.issues
    .map((issue) => `- ${issue.path.join(".")}: ${issue.message}`)
    .join("\n");
  throw new Error(`Invalid environment variables:\n${details}`);
}

export const env: z.output<typeof envSchema> = parsed.data;

// Country ke ISO code (PK, US, GB) se us ke cities
export const getCitySuggestions = (countryCode?: string): string[] => {
  if (!countryCode) return [];

  return (
    City.getCitiesOfCountry(countryCode)
      ?.map((city) => city.name)
      .filter((name, index, array) => array.indexOf(name) === index)
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)) ?? []
  );
};

export const getCityFilterOptions = (countryCode?: string): FilterOption[] => [
  { value: "", label: "All Cities" },
  ...getCitySuggestions(countryCode).map((city) => ({
    value: city,
    label: city,
  })),
];

// Default city list: Pakistan ke cities (jab tak country select na ho)
export const citySuggestions: string[] = getCitySuggestions("PK");

// Country ke NAAM (jaise "Pakistan") se cities. FindMatchSection mein country naam se select hoti hai
export const getCitySuggestionsByCountryName = (countryName?: string): string[] => {
  const country = Country.getAllCountries().find((c) => c.name === countryName);
  return country ? getCitySuggestions(country.isoCode) : citySuggestions;
};

// Sab mulkon ke sab cities (bohat bhari hai, sirf zaroorat par use karein)
export const getAllCitySuggestions = (): FilterOption[] =>
  Country.getAllCountries()
    .flatMap(
      (country) =>
        City.getCitiesOfCountry(country.isoCode)?.map((city) => ({
          value: `${city.name}, ${country.name}`,
          label: `${city.name}, ${country.name}`,
        })) ?? []
    )
    .sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
