/**
 * Profiles ka dummy data. Sab naam aur tafseelat farzi hain (koi asli shakhs nahi).
 * Card aur detail page dono yahin se data parhte hain.
 * Baad mein admin panel / API se yeh data aaye ga: bas `profiles` ki jagah fetch lagayein.
 */
export type Gender = "male" | "female";

export interface PartnerDemands {
  age: string;
  height: string;
  caste: string;
  city: string;
  qualification: string;
  other: string;
}

export interface Profile {
  id: string;
  gender: Gender;
  /** Privacy: pura naam nahi, sirf pehla naam aur last ka pehla harf */
  name: string;
  age: number;
  height: string;
  weight: string;
  maritalStatus: string;
  religion: string;
  sect: string;
  caste: string;
  nationality: string;
  city: string;
  education: string;
  profession: string;
  sector: string;
  monthlyIncome: string;
  fatherOccupation: string;
  motherOccupation: string;
  siblings: string;
  familyType: string;
  homeOwnership: string;
  about: string;
  demands: PartnerDemands;
  /** Photo ka URL. Na ho to placeholder dikhta hai. Photo sirf user ki ijazat se lagayein. */
  photo?: string;
  verified: boolean;
}

type Defaults =
  | "religion"
  | "sect"
  | "nationality"
  | "maritalStatus"
  | "familyType"
  | "homeOwnership"
  | "verified";

  religion: "Islam",
  sect: "Sunni",
  nationality: "Pakistani",
  maritalStatus: "Single",
  familyType: "Nuclear family",
  homeOwnership: "Family home",
  verified: true,
};

const make = (profile: Omit<Profile, Defaults> & Partial<Pick<Profile, Defaults>>): Profile => ({
  ...defaults,
  ...profile,
});

import { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5, // data is fresh for 5 minutes
      gcTime: 1000 * 60 * 30, // unused cache is kept for 30 minutes
      retry: 1,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    },
    mutations: {
      retry: 0, // don't retry form submissions automatically
    },
  },
});

import { env } from "@/lib/env";

/** Builds a wa.me link. Uses the default message from .env unless you pass one. */
export function buildWhatsAppUrl(message: string = env.VITE_WHATSAPP_MESSAGE): string {
  return `https://wa.me/${env.VITE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`;
}

import type { Transition } from "motion/react";

// "Expo out" curve: a fast start and a soft landing
export const easeOutExpo: [number, number, number, number] = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1];

export const transitions: Record<"smooth" | "quick" | "pill", Transition> = {
  smooth: { duration: 0.6, ease: easeOutExpo },
  quick: { duration: 0.25, ease: easeOutExpo },
  pill: { type: "spring", stiffness: 380, damping: 32 },
};

import type { Variants } from "motion/react";
import { easeOutExpo } from "@/lib/animations/transitions";

export const fadeIn: Variants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, transition: { duration: 0.5, ease: easeOutExpo } },
};

export const fadeUp: Variants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 24 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: easeOutExpo } },
};

export const scaleIn: Variants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.92 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, scale: 1, transition: { duration: 0.5, ease: easeOutExpo } },
};

// Parent: its children with fadeUp/scaleIn animate one after another
export const staggerContainer: Variants = {
  hidden: {},
  visible: {
    transition: { staggerChildren: 0.08, delayChildren: 0.05 },
  },
};

// Route change: fade and slide in, fade and slide out
export const pageVariants: Variants = {
  initial: { opacity: 0, y: 16 },
  animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.45, ease: easeOutExpo } },
  exit: { opacity: 0, y: -10, transition: { duration: 0.2, ease: "easeIn" } },
};

import { z } from "zod";

const MARITAL_FILTER_VALUES = ["never_married", "divorced", "widowed", "separated"] as const;

const text = z.string().trim().max(60, "This is too long");
const age = z.string().regex(/^(?:\d{2})?$/, "Pick an age");

export const matchFilterSchema = z
  .object({
    gender: z.enum(["", "bride", "groom"]),
    caste: text,
    maritalStatus: z.enum(["", ...MARITAL_FILTER_VALUES] as const),
    city: text,
    country: text,
    religion: text,
    sect: text,
    education: text,
    ageFrom: age,
    ageTo: age,
    q: text,
  })
  .refine(
    (values) => !values.ageFrom || !values.ageTo || Number(values.ageFrom) <= Number(values.ageTo),
    {
      message: "Age To must be the same or higher",
      path: ["ageTo"],
    },
  );

export type MatchFilterInput = z.input<typeof matchFilterSchema>;
export type MatchFilterOutput = z.output<typeof matchFilterSchema>;

export const emptyFilters: MatchFilterInput = {
  gender: "",
  caste: "",
  maritalStatus: "",
  city: "",
  country: "",
  religion: "",
  sect: "",
  education: "",
  ageFrom: "",
  ageTo: "",
  q: "",
};

FILE: src\schemas\register.schema.ts
========================================
import { z } from "zod";

// ------------------------------
// Constants
// ------------------------------

const MIN_AGE = 18;
const MAX_AGE = 70;

// Pakistani mobile: +92 3XX XXXXXXX, 0092 3XX XXXXXXX, 92 3XX XXXXXXX or 03XX XXXXXXX
// (spaces and dashes are ignored)
const PK_MOBILE = /^(\+92|0092|92|0)3\d{9}$/;

// Names: letters (any language), spaces, dot, apostrophe, hyphen
const NAME_RE = /^[\p{L}][\p{L}\s.'-]*$/u;

// General text: letters, numbers, spaces and common punctuation (no < > { } etc.)
const TEXT_RE = /^[\p{L}\p{N}\s.,&()/'"+-]+$/u;

// ------------------------------
// Helpers
// ------------------------------

interface TextOptions {
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  pattern?: RegExp;
  patternMessage?: string;
}

/** Required text field with clear messages for empty / too short / too long / bad characters */
const text = (label: string, options: TextOptions = {}) => {
  const { min = 2, max = 100, pattern = TEXT_RE, patternMessage } = options;
  return z
    .string({ error: `${label} is required` })
    .trim()
    .min(1, `${label} is required`)
    .min(min, `${label} must be at least ${min} characters`)
    .max(max, `${label} must be at most ${max} characters`)
    .regex(pattern, patternMessage ?? `${label} contains invalid characters`);
};

const personName = (label: string) =>
  text(label, {
    min: 3,
    max: 60,
    pattern: NAME_RE,
    patternMessage: `${label} can only contain letters and spaces`,
  });

/** Optional text: may be empty, but not too long */
const optionalText = (label: string, max: number) =>
  z.string().trim().max(max, `${label} must be at most ${max} characters`).default("");

/** Whole number from 0 to 20 (stored as text, like the form gives it) */
const count = (label: string) =>
  z
    .string({ error: `${label} is required` })
    .trim()
    .min(1, `${label} is required`)
    .regex(/^\d{1,2}$/, `${label} must be a whole number`)
    .refine((value) => Number(value) <= 20, `${label} cannot be more than 20`);

const mobileNumber = (label: string) =>
  z
    .string({ error: `${label} is required` })
    .trim()
    .min(1, `${label} is required`)
    .refine(
      (value) => PK_MOBILE.test(value.replace(/[\s-]/g, "")),
      `${label} must be a valid Pakistani mobile number, e.g. +92 300 1234567`,
    );

/** "5'7\"" -> 67 (inches). Returns null if the format is wrong. */
function heightToInches(value: string): number | null {
  const match = /^(\d)'(\d{1,2})"$/.exec(value.trim());
  if (!match) return null;
  const feet = Number(match[1]);
  const inches = Number(match[2]);
  if (inches > 11) return null;
  return feet * 12 + inches;
}

const isValidHeight = (value: string) => {
  const inches = heightToInches(value);
  return inches !== null && inches >= 48 && inches <= 84; // 4'0" to 7'0"
};

/** Partner height: "Any", "5'6\"", or "5'6\" and above/below" */
const isValidHeightDemand = (value: string) => {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (/^any$/i.test(trimmed)) return true;
  return isValidHeight(trimmed.replace(/\s+and\s+(above|below)$/i, ""));
};

/** Partner age: "Any", "25 - 32", "25 to 32", "Above 50" */
const isValidAgeDemand = (value: string) => {
  const s = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (s === "any") return true;

  const above = /^(?:above|over)\s+(\d{2})$/.exec(s);
  if (above) {
    const age = Number(above[1]);
    return age >= MIN_AGE && age <= 80;
  }

  const range = /^(\d{2})\s*(?:-|to)\s*(\d{2})$/.exec(s);
  if (range) {
    const from = Number(range[1]);
    const to = Number(range[2]);
    return from >= MIN_AGE && to <= 80 && from <= to;
  }
  return false;
};

/** "YYYY-MM-DD" (date input) -> Date, or null if it is not a real calendar date */
function parseDate(value: string): Date | null {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(value);
  if (!match) return null;
  const year = Number(match[1]);
  const month = Number(match[2]);
  const day = Number(match[3]);
  const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
  const isReal =
    date.getFullYear() === year && date.getMonth() === month - 1 && date.getDate() === day;
  return isReal ? date : null;
}

function calculateAge(birthDate: Date, today = new Date()): number {
  let age = today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear();
  const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - birthDate.getMonth();
  if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < birthDate.getDate())) age -= 1;
  return age;
}

/** Empty text is NaN, so "not filled yet" is never treated as 0 */
const toNumber = (value: string) => (value.trim() === "" ? Number.NaN : Number(value));

// ------------------------------
// Schema
// ------------------------------

export const registerSchema = z
  .object({
    // Personal details
    gender: z.enum(["male", "female"], { error: "Please select a gender" }),
    fullName: personName("Full name"),
    dateOfBirth: z
      .string({ error: "Date of birth is required" })
      .trim()
      .min(1, "Date of birth is required")
      .superRefine((value, ctx) => {
        if (!value) return;

        const birthDate = parseDate(value);
        if (!birthDate) {
          ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Please enter a valid date of birth" });
          return;
        }

        const today = new Date();
        const startOfToday = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate());
        if (birthDate >= startOfToday) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            message: "Date of birth cannot be today or a future date",
          });
          return;
        }

        const age = calculateAge(birthDate);
        if (age < MIN_AGE) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            message: `You must be at least ${MIN_AGE} years old to register`,
          });
        } else if (age > MAX_AGE) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            message: `Please enter a valid date of birth (maximum age is ${MAX_AGE})`,
          });
        }
      }),
    height: z
      .string({ error: "Height is required" })
      .trim()
      .min(1, "Height is required")
      .refine(isValidHeight, `Select a height between 4'0" and 7'0"`),
    weight: z
      .string({ error: "Weight is required" })
      .trim()
      .min(1, "Weight is required")
      .refine((value) => {
        const match = /^(\d{2,3})\s*kg$/i.exec(value);
        return match !== null && Number(match[1]) >= 40 && Number(match[1]) <= 150;
      }, "Select a weight between 40 kg and 150 kg"),
    disability: optionalText("Disability", 100),
    maritalStatus: z.enum(["never_married", "divorced", "widowed", "separated"], {
      error: "Please select a marital status",
    }),

    // Education and career
    qualification: text("Qualification", { max: 80 }),
    institution: text("College/University", { min: 3, max: 100 }),
    occupation: text("Job / Business", { max: 80 }),
    sector: z.enum(["government", "private", "business"], {
      error: "Please select government, private or own business",
    }),
    jobNature: text("Nature of job", { max: 60 }),
    monthlyIncome: text("Monthly income", { min: 1, max: 40 }),

    // Religion and home
    religion: text("Religion", { max: 50 }),
    sect: text("Sect", { max: 50 }),
    caste: text("Caste", { max: 50 }),
    homeOwnership: z.enum(["owned", "rented", "family"], {
      error: "Please select home ownership",
    }),
    homeSize: text("Home size", { min: 1, max: 40 }),
    area: text("Location / Area", { min: 3, max: 100 }),
    city: text("City", { max: 60 }),
    nationality: text("Nationality", { max: 40 }),
    vehicle: z.enum(["none", "bike", "car", "both"], { error: "Please select a vehicle option" }),
    otherProperties: optionalText("Other properties", 300),

    // Family details
    fatherName: personName("Father's name"),
    fatherOccupation: text("Father's occupation", { max: 60 }),
    motherOccupation: text("Mother's occupation", { max: 60 }),
    totalSiblings: count("Total siblings"),
    brothers: count("Number of brothers"),
    sisters: count("Number of sisters"),
    marriedBrothers: count("Married brothers"),
    marriedSisters: count("Married sisters"),

    // Partner demands
    prefAge: z
      .string({ error: "Age limit is required" })
      .trim()
      .min(1, "Age limit is required")
      .refine(isValidAgeDemand, "Enter an age range like 25 - 32 (18 to 80), or choose Any"),
    prefHeight: z
      .string({ error: "Preferred height is required" })
      .trim()
      .min(1, "Preferred height is required")
      .refine(isValidHeightDemand, `Choose a height (4'0" to 7'0") or Any`),
    prefCaste: text("Preferred caste", { max: 60 }),
    prefSect: text("Preferred sect", { max: 60 }),
    prefCity: text("Preferred city", { max: 60 }),
    prefQualification: text("Preferred qualification", { max: 80 }),
    otherRequirements: optionalText("Other requirements", 500),

    // Contact details
    phone: mobileNumber("Phone number"),
    whatsapp: mobileNumber("WhatsApp number"),

    // Declaration (checkbox)
    declaration: z
      .boolean()
      .refine((value) => value, "Please confirm the declaration to continue"),
  })
  // Cross-field checks for siblings (errors show on the exact field)
  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
    const total = toNumber(data.totalSiblings);
    const brothers = toNumber(data.brothers);
    const sisters = toNumber(data.sisters);
    const marriedBrothers = toNumber(data.marriedBrothers);
    const marriedSisters = toNumber(data.marriedSisters);

    if (![total, brothers, sisters].some(Number.isNaN) && total !== brothers + sisters) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["totalSiblings"],
        message: `Total siblings must equal brothers + sisters (${brothers + sisters})`,
      });
    }

    if (![marriedBrothers, brothers].some(Number.isNaN) && marriedBrothers > brothers) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["marriedBrothers"],
        message: "Married brothers cannot be more than the number of brothers",
      });
    }

    if (![marriedSisters, sisters].some(Number.isNaN) && marriedSisters > sisters) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["marriedSisters"],
        message: "Married sisters cannot be more than the number of sisters",
      });
    }
  });

/** What the form fields hold while the user types */
export type RegisterInput = z.input<typeof registerSchema>;

/** The parsed, validated values passed to onSubmit */
export type RegisterOutput = z.output<typeof registerSchema>;
